items: Required checks are produced by the workflow in the pull request's own head. A pull request that edits .github/workflows/ci.yml can change what the required checks execute; the fence proves only that GitHub Actions reported success under the required names. Workflow changes therefore need independent review before merge.
The administrator disable-push-re-enable sequence described under bypass_classification.residual.

merge_identity.correction: The first 00C candidate (ce7827b9) claimed that rebase merges use GitHub's noreply identity as committer. That was false: provider merges stamp the merging account's commit email. Identity safety rests on the verified account privacy setting, checked on every canonical commit by tests/test_integration_hardening.py.
